title: Systems Thinking Is Vital in the Age of AI
caption:
AI is handling the technical heavy lifting, but the role of the engineer is actually becoming more complex. It's no longer just about technical mastery; it's about systems thinking and coordinating human expertise.

Source: Spectrum - Systems Thinking Is Vital in the Age of AI

https://spectrum.ieee.org/systems-thinking-vital-in-ai
